nom: Origins Super Spot Remover Acne Treatment Gel with Salicylic Acid

avis.texte: Tiny bottle that lasts a long while! Super effective. Is a go to repurchase.
I think this may work for those who dont have "Acne" per-se but the occasional pimple/small bumps. This little bottle lasted me over a year and worked overnight every time! A little goes a long way.
I was surprised how small the bottle was. Seemed like a sample size.
It seems they chase their packaging and the product now comes half empty. Very strange.

Of the salicylic acid-based acne topicals out there, I love this one best. Totally buying this again. However, I'm hoping Origins will reconsider the packaging. It is hard to control the squeeze and how much product comes out when you only need a little dab. Would recommend a tube with the more pointed tip to prevent wasted (pricey) product and dried, caked-on residue around the bottle.

avis.titre: Best and most effective acne treatment EVER!
avis.texte: I am here to tell you this product is like gold to me! You MUST read this! I have been using this product daily since October (4 months now) before writing this review. It WORKS! I have suffered with acne my whole life. I have very sensitive skin and I can't use most products, especially products designed to treat acne. My skin always looks red. Things I've tried in the past were too harsh on my skin, burned, made things worse, too drying, allergic, etc. Now as an adult in their late 20s I still suffer with breakouts. I have found the Orgins Mega Mushroom line to be the only skin care brand to truly work for me and I have been using it for about 2 years now. It calms my skin and keeps it moisturized through out the day without being too oily or clogging pores. Although that skin care routine with the Mega Mushroom line felt like a miracle on my skin, I would still have white heads and breakouts. Then I found this! It is the ONLY product that works fast with overnight results! It's like a miracle patch that stops the acne almost immediately and in the morning you see the spot has reduced significantly or at least the white head is gone. I apply a small amount with a q-tip to each spot at night and in the morning after washing my face followed by the Mega Mushroom line of products. It doesn't irritate the skin or burn. I can not express to you how well this product works. You might think this is such a tiny bottle, but it lasts a long time! You just need a very small amount to
This is my go-to for my occasional breakouts. Helps reduce the redness from breakouts.

I've been using this for 20 years, a little goes a long way. As soon as you feel a blemish starting apply this and it's gone. Not a sign in sight of it. Esp amazing to work overnight magic. You need just a small little dab. A bottle lasts a year. This is magic in a bottle!
I've been ising this product for years. Whenever I get a breakout I apply directly on the pimple and it dries it right up.
Highly recommend!! Make sure you look at the size oz. because when I got it I didn't realize how small it was going to be. Works wonders!!

avis.titre: Luv this!!! Works and always order 2 !! Definitely Try
avis.texte: I have combination skin but will not be without this wonderful item that quickly and gently takes care of any pop up blemishes. So happy it is a gel with no residue or burning easy to use on bare skin or under makeup with no rolling off nice & smooth application and dries quickly. This sells out fast & often. I have recommended to friends and family with all very positive feedback!! Truly a wonderful item and does not dry out lasts and is truly magic in a bottle! Thank you Origins again for a quality product!

My mom gave me a bottle of this stuff and WOW. I'm truly so impressed. I suffer from hormonal breakouts (often those pesky ones that hover under the skin for a bit before popping up), and this product zaps em before they even get a chance.

avis.titre: Skin felt like it was burning
avis.texte: I'm sure this product works well for a lot of people (there are a lot of positive reviews), but I have sensitive skin and after trying it once, my skin felt like it was burning.

This product works well for making break outs disappear quicker than they would without using it. A little goes a long way with this stuff. Just a small dab of product for the area and, Boom, you're good to go! It dries quick too so you're not having to worry about it just caked on your face. I was really iffy because of the price and the size but it's definitely a tiny but might product lol.

Love this little Miracle in a bottle. It is a little expensive for the package size but I'll just have to eat that expense cuz the way this little bottle cleared up week old acne, deep painful acne and even the hormonal acne on my jawline in hours or overnight is insane. But pls do moisturize after it can be a little drying. This is hands down the best spot treatment I've ever used imma keep buying it and stock up when I do buy it 🤤🤤😫❤️

Have been using in for some years now and I like it. It can sting when putting it on, but it does make pimples go away faster. It leaves a shear coat that's quite shiny compared to skin and up close you can see it. It can peal so I would not put foundation over, but powder is fine.

This spot remover works so well. A little goes a long way. Not oily. Feels soft on skin. Works Well for one as well as clusters of acne. Fast acting - 5-6 days for spots that had been on there for a few weeks. 2 days if new spot.

I love this product and I have tried numerous spot treatments that never worked for me. As soon as I see a pimple forming I put this on and it is gone overnight. I have rarely had to use it more than 2-3 times on the same spot.

avis.titre: Works amazing! Definitely will buy again!
avis.texte: This product worked wonders on my acne around my nose and on my chin. After two or three uses, along with my usual skin care (makeup remover, facial scrub, and water) it was like there was never acne there in the first place! Though it is a tiny bottle, it will last you a long time. One little dot of this product is all you need for it to work. I will be purchasing this again

this burns so terribly after every time i use this. it also completely dries out your skin wherever you apply it and i have oily skin myself. i currently have a huge scab under my eyebrow and other scabs from pimples because this product made my skin dry out horribly. it's also pretty expensive with so little product
I've used this product since I was in middle school, and there's a reason. this little bottle is so gosh darn effective. would highly recommend.

I have to admit that this has done me WONDERS. I've been using this product for years, however it's just as effective as it was when I was a teen. I am getting closer to my mid-20s now and this product saved me throughout my breakouts. I still do have breakouts there and then, but once I do put it on the acne fades within a few days. The negative side is that it DRIES out your skin. So, I highly recommend investing in a "Hydrating Moisturizer." I'd also like to point out that this product doesn't fade the acne scars either, but that doesn't bother me at all. I only bought it for the intention to remove acne, I just had to focus on both rehydrating my skin and using serums for the hyperpigmentation afterwards. The product does what it's meant to do, so I'll continue to invest on the Acne Spot Remover.

avis.titre: Trying to find a new product after I finish using this
avis.texte: At first I went to exchange this because it looked like 50% of the product was used. I went to check the others and they are all the same. Ridiculous, I've bought this in the past and they have always filled it now they're out here scamming.

avis.titre: Didn't make much of a difference
avis.texte: I love Origin products, I have used this many times, and when it goes on you can feel it working, it tightens and tingles. But as far as removing the spot, I don't really see a difference even after repeated use. Maybe save your money when it comes to this one.
This product is not for me, it made my skin worse if anything!

I have hormonal acne and sensitive skin, and nothing really works to help calm and clear breakouts. This product is MAGIC. It is the only product I've found that will help clear up pimples in just a few days and can help prevent upcoming breakouts from getting worse. It does have a strong smell but does not irritate my skin at all. If you're on the fence, buy it!! A little bit goes a long way

avis.titre: Works for removal of acne NOT on discoloration
avis.texte: I used this product mainly for discoloration from acne spots left after. I hardly have any acne now in my 30's, i did not notice any difference or lightening of those areas on my skin. I did use however on my husband on his acne areas and overnight they were gone! So i would recommend as a spot remover NOT for discoloration areas or lightening of acne scars.

I never get acne, so I'm not sure on the lifespan of a pimple but when I do I use this. It goes away in 1 or 2 days. I love it. I only wear it at night so it's not on very long. Once it dries it is a little hard to wash off, A good scrub is needed. I do like the size of the bottle because it's relatively small and is easy to travel with. Again I absolutely love this product. But...I have very sensitive skin. I can't even use makeup removal. This product burned, it burn in bad tingling. It's horrible. But it works so all I can say is beauty is pain. But if I ever hang out with someone and they have acne I'll always take this with me. Gotta spread the joy

avis.titre: High hopes turned to major disappointment
avis.texte: This product did nothing to help with any breakouts I had. I did not see any difference when using this product after 4+ days.

I 100000000% recommend this to anyone struggling with acne!!! Clears my face up within a blink of an eye!! Just dab a little bit on a pimple coming in or existing ones & it takes care of it super fast! Worth having in case of emergencies:)
Love how well this works on your face, BUT it dries it out so bad. which is understandable so I am not complaining, just a warning. But I will say for the size of the product is VERY expensive.

I very rarely review products but I had to take the time to review this one. I've been struggling with hormonal pregnancy acne for 5 months and NOTHING helped. This stuff cleared it up in a week, and I even saw results overnight. A little goes a long way. Some people say salicylic acid isn't safe for pregnancy but my doctor said it's safe for topical use (not safe for ingestion). I'm SO glad I found this product! Now I really do have that pregnancy glow I've been waiting for!

This is the best acne spot remover I have ever used and I've tried A LOT of them. This dries out a pimple really fast. As others have said it does dry to a white film but I've found that if you don't use a lot that doesn't happen. A little goes a long way and this bottle will last you a long time. I apply a small amount with a q-tip and it works really well. For reference I'm 38 years old and I get a few pimples here and there when I have my period or my skin gets irritated from wearing an N95 all day at work. I highly recommend this.
Love this acne treatment. It works very well with my oily, acne prone skin. Just wish it came in a bigger size!

I love this product so much! I have been using for a year I think! It has lasted me so long and I still have more! It works so well!!! Can get rid of a pimple in 5 days or less! It stings a bit though! Amazing! Will be buying again!
It worked immediately for me I just bought it a couple days ago cysts are gone

avis.titre: For the under the skin cysts!
avis.texte: My skin is a mix of hormonal acne and clogged pores. I get a few under the skin cysts every few weeks around my chin that are hormonal. Usually the Mario badescu drying lotion is my go to for white heads/ calming clogged pores but for cysts it's hit or miss. I wish I could show you how bad my last cystic pimple was on my cheek! It lasted for 2 weeks not budging at all until I took a chance with this origins spot gel and omg! My new holy grail! The cyst started getting smaller after 1 night, and it's fully drained one week later. This is the best!! It also didn't burn my sensitive skin although I feel a tingle each time.

avis.titre: I noticed a difference in 3 days!
avis.texte: Using s directed for Adult acne and terrible skin. I noticed a difference in 3 days and will continue to use it.

I'm not sure how or why but this has always been able to clear up blemishes quickly for me. My skin is oily and acne-prone. When I see a red or white bump forming I dab a drop of Super Spot Remover and the pimple clears in a day or two. This is clear, the smell is not strong, and the bottle will last a while. Paired with the Zero Oil products this has been a must-have for me for years.

I used this once in my early 20s and was MORTIFIED when my face dried out so badly in the spot it was more red and noticeable than before, so I threw it away. Now in my late 30s I got it again in a sampler pack and thought I'd give it a try on a random zit (I rarely break out like that as an adult). Big. Mistake. Same result. Right to the trash and never again.

I've tried this a few times, it does help clearing up overnight white heads on a few treatments. I do have a very slight stinging sensation when first applied and it does dry out the skin in the area. it has a sticky kinda tacky feeling but it does dry down. depending on how many breakouts I have I can have this last for a few weeks to a little over a month.

avis.titre: Best spot treatment out of many
avis.texte: I've tried so many different acne spot treatments and this one has to be the best. It does it's job really well without causing too much irritation or dryness, and I find it only takes 1-2 applications for the blemish to go away.

I added this to my beauty routine. I have congested pores in my T zone - nose and cheeks. This product, combined with my cleansing routine is clearing up the congested pores. It has a medicinal smell so one drawback.
will always get this spot remover! does wonders within a week or less!

So I had this pimple that decided to torment my entire being this week. I tried the Mira's spot treatment, the Mario Badescu one, and one of those sticker spot treatments. The darn thing was untouched, mocking me. I looked up reviews on spot treatments and read good ones on this Origins one. Let me tell you that I used it the night before and the next morning, significantly reduced in redness and size. Like 80%. This stuff is amazing.
I love this product. Works so good i wont change or try another product.

It doesn't work ,Don't buy. If you need to return it, it is very difficult, it took me almost a month to apply for a return, still unsuccessful, they do not send me the return label. You want to try to use it. be careful.

I've had this product for about a year and have been waiting to write a review to make sure it works - and wow does it work! I use it primarily to dry out any pimples that pop up. It quickly dries - and I mean like a DESERT - any blemish within 12 hours, and they're usually gone completely within 24-48 hours. My only issue is that it dries out the area around the blemish as well, but if you're really careful about application, it turns out fine. Also, it's a TINY bottle, but a pin-size drop goes a long way! 100% recommend.

This thing is amazing! I had a huge pimple, one of those red painful ones on my chin. I applied this on at night and in the morning it was gone! I had been using Mario Badescu forever and had noticed any improvements so I decided to try this one from Origins and I'm so glad I did. The only bad thing is that the bottle is super tiny.
I combine this with the out of touble mask. I do a layer of spot remover, followed by a layer of out of trouble, then another layer of spot remover to seal it all together. Works every time
I get really bad acne clusters on my skin, like little spots that other products don't get rid of. I put this on my skin and boom, it's gone.
This stuff works overnight!!!! Anytime I start to get a pimple I put it on at night and in the morning it's gone!!!!

I am a looooong time Origins user but used an awesome < edit> spot treatment product for acne. They've recently discontinued it. I have been searching for a replacement for nearly a year. I couldn't believe I didn't just check Origins. Right under my nose was the perfect replacement. Ounce for ounce the other product was less expensive (but still pricey) and unfortunately the Origins product is really expensive for the size/volume of product. BUT… it does work and you don't need much. The bottle is teenie tiny tho and I wish it was twice as big at least! I do recommend it as a replacement for < edit> Overnight Clearing Gel.
You just put a small dab on the zit you want gone and it dries up so fast.

I used to sell the brand and I will never stop using this. Great for cystic acne. It's job is to bring that pimple into full cycle bring gunk to the surface so can be off your face sooner. If you get another it's because gunk needed to surface as well. I recommend doing a nice deep cleaning mask then use for spots!!

I used to sell the brand and I will never stop using this. Great for cystic acne. It's job is to bring that pimple into full cycle bring gunk to the surface so can be off your face sooner. If you get another it's because gunk needed to surface as well. I recommend doing a nice deep cleaning mask then use for spots!!

avis.titre: Didn't Help and Caused More to Show up
avis.texte: I've noticed that the next day after I use this, I have a new whitehead. Some are right next to the "treated" spot! Also burns when I apply.

I want to start off by saying that I love all of the other Origins products I've purchased, and use them daily (the Zero Oil toner and the Checks & Balances cleanser are amazing!). I bought this super spot remover and did not have the same experience as I have had with my other Origins products. My face broke out worse than it had been in years after using this product for a couple of weeks (changing nothing else in my skincare routine). I had to stop using it and switch back to my old spot remover from a different brand. I will continue to use Origins for my other skincare needs, but unfortunately, will not be buying the spot remover again.

avis.titre: This is one of the best products I have ever found!
avis.texte: I have never found a product that works as quickly as this does on a breakout. I swear it works overnight after the first application. I have been using it for years and would never buy anything else.

I have been using this product for over 3 weeks and worked real nice. I don't have sensitive skin but I suffer from rosacea. This is what I do before using the spot treatment (for night time): Clean my face with cerave cleanser with S.A, then I apply 1. Tonic 2. Retinol ( helps with acne and spots) 3. Moisturizer( light one) 4. Eye cream 5. Moisturizer(cream one) 5. Spot treatment. I make sure my skin is well hydrated and I only use 1 drop per zone. This has been amazing. I was able to see progress within 1 week. using it with the correct products for your skin type enhances the results. I always use it 2 times a day and every day I do my night skincare routine. My acne is under control now and I can see my spots getting a lot better. Enjoy!

I got this in a set and I was really looking forward to using it. However, I have used it for months and seen no results at all. It burns terribly when you put it on and doesn't even get rid of the acne even with multiple uses.
This just did absolutely nothing for my acne. And it's nothing crazy, just small whiteheads and blackheads. I used with other acne products, clinique spot gel works a lot better.
I thought it worked for the first 1 week and a half of using this product. However, it doesn't do anything to help reduce my pimples. Don't waste your money

I got this as an alternative to the Mario drying lotion and I have to say I like that one better. While I do think this does help pimples not get as big it is inconsistent in helping them go away faster. Some breakouts went away after applying a couple of times while other didn't seem to be affected at all. The small size would be nice for travel and I like that it is just a gel as opposed to a liquid with powder (like the Mario one). Because it is so small and you have to squeeze out the gel it can be hard to control how much comes out.
I enjoyed the results from this. I am definitely a fan of this brand now and I will be looking into purchasing more skin care products from them.

avis.titre: Doesn't work and leaves a film
avis.texte: I wouldn't buy this again. It isn't nearly as effect as, say, the Clean & Clear or Neutrogena spot gels I used in my twenties. On top of that, it dries with this awful film you can see -- maybe okay if you're pale but not on a darker skin tone. All it did was dry out my skin where applied without actually reducing the blemish at ALL.

avis.titre: If you have sensitive skin, please refrain from using this!!
avis.texte: I'm sure that this product is great for some people and I wish that I could use it too as it actually got rid of my spots. However, I've had the worst allergic reaction to it and my cheek is now covered in red dots and it won't go away even though I've stopped using it. I would strongly recommend doing a patch test before using this product to make sure that you're not allergic to one of the ingredients. I'm really scared that my skin won't go back to normal as I rarely ever get spots and now my skin has never looked worse. As I said, I'm sure this is a great product for some people, but please be wary, I wish I was before I started using it.
Feels very refreshing at first but then hardens and makes your face feel very stiff. Also, didn't see that it made an actual difference to my skin.

Ever since COVID I started getting pimples on my face from wearing masks. Since using this they disappear within a day or two. When I used it too much my skin does get a little dry, but not terribly. I've already repurchased.
This acne spot treatment worked well on unexpected pimples or small areas of irritation/acne that randomly popped up!! Did not irritate my skin or dry out my already dry skin anymore
Overall, I enjoyed this product for my oily skin. I really love Origins brand products, and will continue to recommend to any one with problem skin. I loved it!

avis.titre: love this as a spot treatment
avis.texte: This works especially for maskne and as a treatment for underneath your mask. It does flake up a bit but when you are going to bed or wearing your mask out that doesn't matter.

I did not care for this item at all, it smells horrible, it has this very strongly scented bitter scent that doesn't really dry well and its very sticky. I did not notice it helping with my acne very much either but I like the idea of a gel spot treatment.

I love how the product smells for but it has helped treat my acne and it works different on others so don't get your hopes up if you decide to try it and it doesn't work! But I recommend to whom ever reading to buy!

avis.titre: I would purchase again. A little goes a long way
avis.texte: Great product... it works. Use it daily or as needed and u will see results. I was eyeing it for a while and was hesitant and needed something very effective so I decided to purchase it and I have no regrets🤞

I really wanted to like this product, especially because Origins has a reputation for being a clean brand. I applied the gel on a pimple that just popped up that evening, and went to bed. The next morning, it was very red, swollen, and enlarged. I believe it made it worse than if I had left it alone. I am very disappointed.

When I saw the active ingredient was the same as most other drug store brands, I was very skeptical to purchase. They only reason I did was honestly excuse Origins and I are besties so I'm not often disappointed. Boy am I glad I made this purchase!! I have a terrible habit of picking at my face and where this product didn't help tremendously on new blemishes it cleared older ones that I had destroyed literally overnight! Redness and all! I will definitely purchase again as the decreased healing time helped me to keep my hands away from my face!
Love this spot treatment, as soon as you put it on you already feel it working. You can see the difference by the next day, the redness and sensitivity around the pimple is gone.

I received this complimentary to try out - the size was super small but you only need a tiny bit of product! It was definitely tingling at first but didn't bother my skin. I feel like it helped a little bit with blemishes but not as good as the blemish spots that some other brands have. I'd like to try some of the other products with it to see if there's more of a difference!

avis.titre: Most likely a one time purchase
avis.texte: I purchased this product because the reviews online had this on the highest pedestal. I have been using this for about 3 weeks and I see no change. No change in size of pimples, no change is discoloration from old bumps, nothing. There is a bit of a tingle if the bump is open, say you popped it and then applied this product, there is a mild tingle. For the most part it goes on like a gel, and dries like Elmers glue that you peel off the next morning. Based on reviews this really works for some, but I wont purchase again.
Especially in these times of wearing masks, this is an amazing spot remover for acne. It really works!!
It dried out my breakouts instantly! I wish the smell was a bit better
I've been having breakouts lately and this spot treatment has worked wonders. Whenever I use it, the next morning my blemishes seem much smaller.

This is not a good acne product. I used it and it did nothing to remove any spots or shrink any pimples I've put it on. Worst of all it feels like putting hair gel on your skin. It dries up and leaves the skin its been applied to stiff and it feels weird. I definitely will not buy this in the future.
I have been using this product for couple days and I haven't seen results. Maybe with time I will see a difference but for now I can't recommend this product.
I love this spot treatment. I have very sensitive skin but this gently improves hard spots. I have struggled with acne for years and have scars, so this really has helped minimize those spots.

Origins has long been a favorite brand of mine. I have sensitive skin and this product didn't make me react or have any irritation. It did not cause any dryness or weird patches and I couldn't be happier with the results.
I love this spot treatment. It helps zap away zits quickly and isnt drying. I love everything from origins and this makes me love it more!

This product has a really strange scent, but it is so powerful that I don't really care. If you use it right before bed, you'll be pleasantly surprised at how much it does and how well it works. The texture isn't too thin or thick, which I like. Application is the same as a lot of other spot treatments I've tried, so it's pretty standard and easy to use. I have had some stubborn adult acne lately, and I think I've found a realistic solution.

I received the acne spot treatment and I have to say that it has saved my skin! I am in my early 30s and I get hormonal breakouts around the time of my period. They are usually cystic acne and very hard to treat. Using the origins super spot remover cleared them right up! I am impressed!
Hello So I wasn't expecting how good it actually made my skin feel. The serum is a bit weird but it works for time you just gotta be patience.

This small bottle packs a mean punch with getting rid of spots. I've had a troublesome spot on my face from an acne scar that just wouldn't go away. After using this product, that troublesome spot is starting to disappear! I'm shockedddddd! Shout-out to BZZAgent for allowing me to try this product for free!!!
I get lots of pimples during that time of month and the cystic ones this really helps out alot. I have tried it for 2 months and see a change on my face

I've finally found my holy grail product for my skin. When I say to you that this product does exactly what it says I'm telling the honest truth. Within the next day to week you see a difference. I def recommend this if you have oily acne prone skin and scars.

This product is Super SMALL but does the trick. I have a huge pimple right in the middle of my forehead, applied this overnight and already see a reduction in redness and size. I also have maskne due to this dang pandemic and this product is a LIFESAVER!!!
This worked so good! I loved how much it helped my skin. I have been searching for a product like this for a long time
This product has been great for treating my breakouts due to wearing a mask. It doesn't irritate my skin but truly takes care of the trouble spots.
I love how I leave my skin, super renewed luminous, super healthy.

avis.titre: Origins Super Spot Remover Acne Gel
avis.texte: I do really enjoy this product. It dries quickly and has a faint smell that I'm not sure how to describe but I kind of like it actually lol. I love that it's clear as well. It does dry up blemishes and other breakouts as well pretty quickly. It also does this without drying my skin out too bad, but I would still use a moisturizer afterwards especially if you are prone to dry skin. I would recommend this product to a friend. I received this product for free in exchange for my review. #origins #superspotremover #bzzkit

avis.titre: Origins Spot Remover is the bomb!
avis.texte: I gave it time before I actually reviewed this. It is definitely drying but with a moisturizer over it, it was fine. After 2 weeks, I noticed around my mouth and under eyes were getting lighter. And this is without using any other products along with the spot remover. I'm excited to see what 1 month will do. My face is appearing more even toned! And it gives your skin a glow! I definitely recommend and will be buying once I run out!

avis.titre: I really recommend this to anyone who has ace spots
avis.texte: I wash my face everyday and apply this after i'm done. I didn't think i was working at first and then my spots just went away. ! i really didn't think it was going to work because nothing ever works for my face. I paid a lot of money for this little container but it actually worked ou in the end thankfully! it may take a few weeks depending on how much ace you have. Oh yeah , it also helps the oil in you skin too it make you skin soft and less oily.

I've had acne for about 18 years , have tried over the counter and probably every topical treatment you can name. This product is amazing, you can feel it penetrating your skin and the size of the pimple is literally smaller overnight. Sucks the bottle is so small but totally worth it to me! Will be buying again. Ps this is the first time I have EVER left a review for ANYTHING

Origins SUPER SPOT REMOVER™ Acne Treatment Gel Is hands down one of the best spot treatments I have ever used. Using this gel daily has noticeably improved the areas of my face that have had outbreaks. A little bit of this gel goes a long way. I applied it twice a day (Morning and before Bed). I began to see a difference 2 weeks after using Origins SUPER SPOT REMOVER™ Acne Treatment Gel. To see the best results, you have to use this gel daily.
Salicylic acid is one of the best solutions for acne, atleast for my skin. It comes in a cute little bottle too. It is my go to spot remover now.

I really enjoy the super spot removed acne treatment gel by Origins. I am 5 months postpartum and my hormones are still all out of wack. I am still having major break outs and this spot removed is super helpful. Anytime I feel like I am getting an acne spot I apply it. Often times the spot is gone over night. It's great for acne already on your face as well! A little goes a long way and it's not super harsh on my skin. This product is drying so I definitely wouldn't spread it all over your face but only apply a little on each blemish! Great product!

I was really blown away by this! I use it as a spot treatment on blemishes I feel about to come or already popped up and it stopped them in their tracks!
